items.title: Ecuadorian fishermen sue US over mysterious boat strike
items.brief: Ecuadorian fishermen have filed a lawsuit against the US government over a mysterious attack against their boat involving small, explosive-laden rotor drones, their lawyer Jorge Chiriboga Dávalos announced Tuesday.

items.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ to be reinstated as Nvidia CEO in new statement
